thread:
incident-bot: realtime-detector: p99 latency spike detected on api-prod /v1/stream (region: us-west1). p99=5.8s, p95=1.4s, error rate unchanged. paging oncall @maya :rotating_light:

maya: seeing it on the dashboard. spike started ~1713459960. streaming stalls reported by a handful of enterprise customers. linking live grafana: https://grafana.redwood.internal/d/streaming/latency?orgId=1

chris: I'm oncall rotation but afk for 3m, handing to @maya. grabbing traces and sampling logs now. any quick mitigations we can flip?

maya: doing quick checks:
- pods healthy, CPU/mem ok
- queue length on serving-instances increased ~3x
- KV cache hit rate dropped from 86% -> 54%

zane: KV cache eviction could explain tail latencies for streaming. running redis stat and kvcache diagnostics now.

ops-alerts: alert: routing fallback policy triggered for 3% of requests (model-variant switch).

maya: customer impact: some streaming responses stall during generation (tokens emit with large gaps). visible in user replay. not fully blocked, but p99 > SLO (3s). escalating to live mitigation.

chris: suggestion: enable short-term route to quantized-lite variant for streaming endpoints in us-west1 to shave latency. also enable smaller batch windows for that pool.

maya: agree. plan: 1) enable model-routing fallback to ql-lite for streaming users 2) reduce max-batch-delay to 15ms for streaming lanes 3) force KV cache refresh on serving pool. We'll do them one at a time and watch p99.

emma: tagging product/ps for impacted customers: @ps-team please hold for customer comms if this persists.

maya: applying mitigation 1 -> apictl routing update --route /v1/stream --pool us-west1 --prefer ql-lite --weight 0.2

zane: kicked KV cache compact on pool-gpu-3: redis-cli --scan | xargs redis-cli del; stats show cache warm-up under way.

ops-alerts: action-log: routing update succeeded, KV compact job started.

maya: after routing change p99 dropped to 1.1s within 45s, p95 steady at 1.2s (weird but ok). streaming stalls mostly resolved; observing fewer token gaps.

chris: nice. leave runbook note: rolling rollback if error rate rises >1% or p99 >3s. keep oncall shadow for 30m.

maya: will monitor for 30m then demote to follow-up. creating incident ticket: INC-2026-1143 with initial triage notes and assigned to eng-runtime for postmortem (owner: zane).

zane: will investigate KV cache eviction root cause (suspect GC/oom in cache node or recent model rollout churn). grabbing logs and plan to repro in staging.

incident-bot: incident created INC-2026-1143. pages: eng-runtime, oncall, ps-team.

maya: closing live mitigation phase. p99 now 0.9s, p95 0.8s. moving to monitoring. thanks. :thumbsup:
